items.summary: 7-day window: $351.20 spent, 9,071 impressions, 204 clicks, 18 leads at $19.51 CPL. Top (only spending) campaign: Flooring Problems Campaign.

needs_attention: Last prior meta-ads.json was 2026-09-08 (over a day old); window widened to 7 days (2026-10-05..10-11, cap), so figures are a 7-day total, not yesterday only. Gap before 10-05 not covered.
